raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "send invoices to"
  role subject "the accountant"
  role object "the supplier from Suceava"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "arrive"
    role subject "the invoices"
    role destination "the supplier from Suceava"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
